claims.quote: The red rainbowfish, Glossolepis incisa, is a rainbowfish from the Lake Sentani region of northern New Guinea, Indonesia.
The home of Glossolepis incisus lies in western Papua New Guinea, where it inhabits Lake Sentani and its surroundings.
